title: FieldGuide: A Corpus Map for Token-Efficient Agentic Document Exploration
abstract: arXiv:2611.21647v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative AI agents can help journalists explore large document collections. But exploratory workflows can require substantial token use and time, especially when the task is broad and the relevant subquestions are not yet known. This paper introduces FieldGuide, an agent-facing corpus map that organizes a document collection into a topic hierarchy and exposes tools for corpus orientation, scoped search, and bounded reading. I evaluate FieldGuide on five journalistic document-exploration tasks using 38 Chicago Police Department public-records documents, comparing it with raw-file access and retrieval-augmented generation. Across the five tasks, FieldGuide used 27% fewer tokens and 41% less elapsed time than raw-file access; relative to RAG, it used 38% fewer tokens and 21% less elapsed time. translated_title: FieldGuide：面向智能体高效词元文档探索的语料库地图
translated_abstract: 生成式AI智能体可以帮助记者探索大型文档集合，但探索性工作流程可能需要大量的词元消耗和时间，尤其是当任务范围宽泛且相关子问题尚不明确时。本文介绍了FieldGuide，这是一种面向智能体的语料库地图，它将文档集合组织成主题层次结构，并提供语料库定位、范围化搜索和受限阅读等工具。作者使用38份芝加哥警察局公共记录文档，在五项新闻文档探索任务上对FieldGuide进行了评估，并将其与原始文件访问和检索增强生成（RAG）进行了比较。在这五项任务中，FieldGuide相比原始文件访问少使用了27%的词元和41%的耗时；相比RAG少使用了38%的词元和21%的耗时。准确性审计在FieldGuide的回应中发现了四个小问题，与其他条件相当。在对生成报道的盲评中……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: FieldGuide通过将文档集合组织为主题层次结构并提供定位、范围化搜索和受限阅读工具，使智能体在新闻文档探索任务中相比原始文件访问和RAG基线显著减少词元消耗（27%-38%）和耗时（21%-41%），同时保持相当的准确性。
en_tdlr: FieldGuide, an agent-facing corpus map that organizes documents into a topic hierarchy with tools for orientation, scoped search, and bounded reading, reduces token usage by 27-38% and elapsed time by 21-41% compared to raw-file access and RAG baselines while maintaining comparable accuracy on journalistic exploration tasks.
